title: Owned Edits to a Shared Decision Rule: Learning Private Exceptions as Typed, Gated, Withdrawable Weight Edits
read_level: partial (arXiv HTML v2: abstract, intro, setting/compilation, results 6.1/6.6, failure sections 7.6-7.8, related work, limitations 9.3-9.6, availability; appendix proofs skimmed only)
metadata_mismatch: none for title/authors; HTML read is v2 (15 Nov 2026); in-paper date 11 November 2026 matches metadata first-version date
why_wsp: A published decision rule is compiled exactly into a ReLU network and parties' private exceptions are written as typed, closed-form weight edits into reserved units by a non-LLM gated search; LLMs appear only in pilot arms (free-form weight-edit authoring, reading reports, deciding alone).
domain: multi-party decision rules; spacecraft part derating (radiation test records), synthetic benches
editor: none (typed learner / gated search, no LLM); pilot arms used an unnamed frontier model and unnamed local open-weight models
target: compiled ReLU rule network: synthetic bench 79 parameters; real-record bench 21,213 parameters
interface: closed form (typed declarations compiled to owned weight patches in reserved units)
loop: search (gated search over typed declaration space); an exploratory LLM propose-check-revise loop pilot ran one truth only
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: edits confined to reserved units: 'units 2, 3 and 4 are spare and reserved, one per subject' (Sec 2, synthetic 79-parameter net); count per edit not given as fraction

headline_results.claim: Typed learner 96.6% vs 91.7% unchanged rule at 30 records; no-prior greedy ablation 84.0%
headline_results.quote: the typed learner scored 96.6% at 30 records per party, against 91.7% for the published rule left unchanged.

headline_results.claim: Non-inferior (margin 2 pts) to seven CV-tuned baselines at primary cell
headline_results.quote: the typed learner with the tuned gate was non-inferior to all seven CV-tuned baselines.

headline_results.claim: Typed edits over trained base: +5.4 over base, +3.1 over edits on published rule
headline_results.quote: this combination was +5.4 points (95% interval [ +4.4 , +6.4 ]) more accurate than the trained network alone, and +3.1 points ([ +2.0 , +4.1 ])
the combination minus private fine-tuning was -0.3 points [ -0.9 , +0.2 ].
That network agrees with the line on all 32,975,040 valid inputs, with 0 disagreements.

headline_results.claim: LLM deciding alone about as accurate as patched network
headline_results.quote: a frontier model deciding held-out boundary parts directly scored 347 of 360, against 348 of 360 for the patched network (six calls, one draw).

headline_results.claim: Local LLMs as free-form weight-edit authors made an undetectable error
headline_results.quote: each dropped the heritage term, leaving 1,575 errors on the party's grid. Their edits fitted every record
under the library's default limits it carried 7,989 bits.

baselines_and_controls: Seven CV-tuned baselines (confined gradient learner, Ditto, FedRep, FedAvg, two pooled networks, pooled boosted trees), unchanged published rule, no-prior greedy ablation, oracle-tuned fine-tuning/Ditto as sensitivity, LLM-alone pilot arm.
runs_and_variance: Pre-registered; 20 sampled truths x 5 record draws, 95% t-intervals (df 19), Holm-adjusted p; trained-base test over 40 truths. LLM arms are single calls on one draw: 'The local runs are single calls on one draw.' (Sec 7.7)
robustness_of_edits: Tested contaminated/wrong-party records and label noise for the gate (Sec 7.4); withdrawal and composition in every order checked exhaustively. No quantization/fine-tuning survival test of edits.
verification: exhaustive behavioural checks over all valid inputs (e.g. 0 disagreements on 32,975,040 inputs); proofs of non-interference, exact withdrawal, bounded disclosure (Appendix A); selection-aware Monte Carlo evidence gate
memorization_vs_reasoning: LLM stated rules unstable: 'their stated rules differed on 450 valid items' on identical input (Sec 7.7); LLM loop pilot overfitted its records (2,517 grid errors vs 2,394 for public rule, Sec 7.8).
limitations_stated: Typed space built to contain the owner-specific truths; accuracy evidence synthetic; LLM given records decides about as accurately; properties follow by construction; acceptance test needs a reference set that does not exist; on rule-only base equivalent to a rule table with an owner column; a pre-stated gate criterion failed in both runs; loses at 10 records, shared truths, relaxations.
code_or_data: experimental code in private repository, available from author on request; builds on https://github.com/ruvnet/ruv-FANN/tree/main/packages/wsp

notes_for_survey: Multi-party, owner-attributed, withdrawable weight edits to an exactly compiled rule network; WSP connection is through compilation and closed-form edits, not an LLM editor. Includes a negative pilot where LLM-authored free-form edits fit records but introduced grid errors, and measures hidden information capacity of free-form patches.
